brief:
Ghazal Ihab Khader al-Torok, a child patient at al-Rantisi Pediatric Hospital in Gaza, lies motionless on a treatment bed with her eyes closed, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. A feeding tube runs through her nose to support her breathing and nutrition. She remains largely unresponsive, showing minimal movement or sound.

The girl's severe injuries resulted from Israeli bombardment in Gaza. Her case is among thousands of children treated in Gaza's hospitals for wounds sustained during military operations. Medical staff at al-Rantisi continue providing intensive care to patients with catastrophic injuries, though the hospital operates under severe resource constraints amid the ongoing conflict.

title: Israeli bombardment leaves Gaza girl severely injured, dependent on life support
